text.style: font-size:25px;font-weight:600;font-family:'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif;line-height:1.2

text.tspan: Estimated annual number of deaths from suicide by age. Suicide deaths are underreported in many countries
due to social stigma and cultural or legal concerns. This data is based on modeling of global suicide patterns, and
includes adjustments and extrapolations that aim to account for missing data and underreporting.
Data source: IHME, Global Burden of Disease (2025)
Note: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, this metric is age-standardized.
